status: HISTORICAL - the run that FOUND the cloud freeze, before the fixes (docs/DECISIONS.md D40). Superseded by scale_fleet_20x50.json.
what_happened: 20 devices pushed 5 events each at once. One Qdrant client call hung while holding the cloud store's single global lock, so every push timed out on the device side (5 s timeout).
note: 'not accepted' is NOT data loss: every event stayed in its device's outbox as failed-and-retry, exactly as designed; after the fixes the same test accepted 1,000/1,000 with 0 lost and 0 double-counted.
machine: Intel i5-1335U laptop, all processes on one machine (network = loopback)
